### 0.1854.0

**Shift-clicking coal into a full engine no longer freezes the game**

Shift-clicking coal into a Drifting Engine Block that already held all the coal it could take froze the game. Now the coal just stays in your inventory.

### 0.1847.0

**Discord status**

Your Discord profile now shows you're playing Dungeon Train and where you are. Needs the Discord app open on the same computer. Turn it off any time in Options → Account.
1.21.1.0.1852.0:
**New Content ×1 · Train ×1**

### 0.1852.0

**Another new dimensional carriage room**

One more room can now turn up behind a dimensional carriage door, once you've made it a little way down the line.
1.21.1.0.1851.0:
**Train ×4 · Bug Fix ×3 · New Feature ×1 · New Content ×1 · Editor ×1 · Loot ×1 · Advancements ×1**

### 0.1849.0

**Dimensional carriage editor fix**

Block variants you limit to part of a dimensional carriage now stay out of the rest of it.

**Item fix**

Fixed an item issue in dimensional carriages.

**A new dimensional carriage room**

A new room can now turn up behind a dimensional carriage door. See how far it goes.

### 0.1848.0

**A music disc for a hidden achievement**

One of the hidden achievements now rewards you with a music disc. Already earned it? Your disc is waiting the next time you join.

### 0.1847.0

**TNT traps no longer go off by themselves**

The TNT dimensional carriage and the TNT and easy-trap carriages could explode the moment they appeared, before anyone stepped on a pressure plate. Their plates now start unpressed, so the traps only fire when you step on them.
1.21.1.0.1846.0:
**Bug Fix ×1 · Menus & UI ×1 · Balance ×1**

### 0.1846.0

**Zombified players can no longer reach their backpack**

While Zombified, your backpack is locked just like the rest of your pack: greyed out, nothing goes in or comes out, and pickups skip it.

- The cure hint no longer pops up over items in your backpack; it shows only on the effect itself.
1.21.1.0.1844.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Editor ×1 · Mobs ×1 · Loot ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1844.0

**Life as a zombie**

Turning into a zombie changes how you live. You eat like one, read like one and write like one, your pack is out of reach, and villagers, animals, illagers and other players' echoes all treat you like one.

### 0.1842.0

**Trapped chests in the editor**

Chests in the editor can now be set to spawn as trapped chests, anywhere from 0 to 100% of the time. Some chests on the train now come trapped.

- New Trap button on chest variants in the editor
1.21.1.0.1842.0:
**Bug Fix ×2 · Compatibility ×2**

### 0.1842.0

**CurseForge modpack starts again**

The last few CurseForge modpack versions stopped at an error loading mods. The pack now ships the right version of Interactive Player Mobs.

### 0.1841.0

**Faster creative sprint-flying is back**

Sprint-flying in creative is 3× faster again, and /dt flyspeed changes its speed again. Normal flight and flying up or down are unchanged.
1.21.1.0.1840.0:
**Bug Fix ×1 · Train ×1**

### 0.1840.0

**Dimensional carriage fix**

With Smaller saves turned on, what you leave in a dimensional carriage now stays there after you walk away.

### 0.1839.0

**New advancement**

A new advancement is waiting to be found.

### 0.1837.0

**Photos drift with their carriage**

A photo you hang in a drifting carriage now goes with it, and every world the carriage drifts into shows the picture. While it hangs there it keeps its picture even after its last view, until someone takes it down.

- Works in drifting dimensional carriages too

Distant Horizons no longer interrupts the game at launch with a popup asking you to update it.

### 0.1836.0

**Totem advancements**

New advancements for the Dungeon Totems: be saved by them, collect every kind, try every animal form, cure yourself of zombification and stack them. Four new challenges ask you to carry a full stack, or ride the train as a zombie, for the long haul, and you can track them.

- Totems now only stack when you place one on top of another
- The Totem of Loneliness is now the Totem of Generosity

**Fair play fix**

Fair play fix.

Every photo in your albums now shows a proper place name under it.

1.21.1.0.1810.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Menus & UI ×2 · Community ×1**

### 0.1809.0

**Answers to your feedback**

Ask in your feedback or in chat for something the game already has, like a trash slot, backpacks, inventory sorting or recipe lookup, and a short note now shows you how to find it. Asking for saving mid-run or multiplayer brings a note that both are coming, with a link to the roadmap.

Going live with your mic off now shows a reminder in chat, with a link straight to the Microphone setting. Turning your mic on mid-stream now joins that stream within about half a minute, no need to wait for your next stream. Turn the reminder off from the message itself or in the Stream settings.

1.21.1.0.1799.0:
**New Feature ×3 · Menus & UI ×2 · Performance ×1 · Editor ×1 · World ×1 · Loot ×1 · Balance ×1**

### 0.1799.0

**Stacking totems**

Some totems now stack. Each extra totem in the stack makes its curse one level stronger, up to that curse's strongest level, and a save uses up one totem from the stack.

### 0.1798.0

**Smaller saves option**

A new Smaller saves option on the Options screen's Performance tab keeps your world folder small. Terrain nobody has changed is not saved, and it comes back as before if you ride back. Off by default.

- Your builds, opened chests and the area around you are always kept.

### 0.1796.0

**Flip button in the editor**

The editor's toolbar has a Flip button next to Offset. Click it to pick an axis, then X, Y or Z mirrors your whole build across it. Undo puts it back.

- Flip opens an X / Y / Z row above the build preview
- Each axis button mirrors every block of the plot you're standing in

# Dungeon Totems of Undying

![Dungeon Totems of Undying](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/dungeon-totems-of-undying.gif)

A new set of 19 totems can now be found along the train. Custom made for this modpack. They will still save your life, mostly...

Some might turn you against your friends, others may turn you into a cow, wolf, llama or more. Some might have you think zombification is better than death... if you can turn back.

What else awaits after these totems? The train has the answers.

*Shout out to Lil Detective Crunch (mc: AntonioMacarely) for the idea and help designing this addition to the pack.*
